items.description: This game was created by Emil Vaklinov, a student at Codeclan cohort E23(Edinburgh). It's a Ruby/PostgreSQL/HTML/Sinatra solo project. The idea of the game is to help beginner programmers or kids learn how to code!  This is the trial version released on 25 of July 2018.  To create the game, I used all of the methods that I learned during the first 4 weeks of studying!  "This War is between the new code wizards at CodeClan academy and the dark side of Hogwarts wizardry school.  Lord Valdemort wants to control the codebase system, to get into the Castle of the CodeClanners to enslave them.  Luckily, the spells only lasted 10 seconds, for now!”  We can't escape... We have to fight!!!
